guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 本課以濾程、水頭損失、床層膨脹與恢復為主線，從進水顆粒與濾速、床層與孔隙水、累積壓損與截污、濾程終點比較進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
guides.conceptEn: This course develops filter runs, head loss, bed expansion and return to service through ten connected units, beginning with influent particles and filtration rate, bed and pore water, head-loss growth and retained solids, comparing run endpoints. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

evidence: 在離線工作台先選取「進水顆粒與濾速」的觀測點。逐池量流量與水頭損失，檢查分配不均。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「床層與孔隙水」的觀測點。以床層實測厚度、孔隙估計與示蹤曲線交叉檢查。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「累積壓損與截污」的觀測點。比較進出測壓管水頭並記錄水溫與流量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「濾程終點比較」的觀測點。同步記錄濾程起訖、流量、初濾排放與水質。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「反洗用水收支」的觀測點。比對累積反洗水量、床層膨脹與洗出濁度。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「床層膨脹量測」的觀測點。從多個觀測點比較床高與反洗溫度。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「氣水順序與配水」的觀測點。從多個觀測點比較床高與反洗溫度。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「初濾排放與成熟」的觀測點。對齊排放流量、連續濁度與閥位紀錄，辨識復原期。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「廢水回收與淨產水」的觀測點。用各支線水表重建全週期收支。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「維護後多指標驗證」的觀測點。比較進出測壓管水頭並記錄水溫與流量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
evidenceEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for influent particles and filtration rate. Measure each filter flow/head loss and check maldistribution. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for bed and pore water. Cross-check measured bed depth and estimated porosity against tracer curves. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for head-loss growth and retained solids. Compare inlet/outlet piezometric heads and record temperature and flow. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for comparing run endpoints. Synchronize run start/end, flow, filter-to-waste and quality records. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for backwash-water balance. Compare cumulative backwash volume, bed expansion and washwater turbidity. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for measuring bed expansion. Compare bed height at several points with backwash temperature. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for air-water sequence and distribution. Compare bed height at several points with backwash temperature. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for filter-to-waste and ripening. Align waste flow, continuous turbidity and valve-state records to identify recovery. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for waste recycle and net production. Reconstruct the full-cycle balance from branch meters. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for multi-indicator verification after maintenance. Compare inlet/outlet piezometric heads and record temperature and flow. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
pitfalls: 一池反洗時仍用全廠面積算濾速。診斷與介入：扣掉停用面積重算濾速，核對各池流量與水質。
把砂床總體積當作全是水的體積。診斷與介入：核對有效床深、孔隙估計與旁流，另外量出水顆粒。
壓差上升全歸因濾料堵塞而漏掉流量增加。診斷與介入：比較分層測壓、流量與水溫，區分堵塞與流量變化。
只追求最長運轉時間而忽略穿透。診斷與介入：把終點水質、停洗及初濾損失一併列入可用產水。
將其他濾料或水溫的反洗條件直接複用。診斷與介入：比較水溫、床層膨脹與洗出水，依設備驗證範圍評估。
只看單一角落的床層高度。診斷與介入：在多處量床高與流失濾料，查配水不均。
同一總水量掩蓋局部噴流與死角。診斷與介入：在多處量床高與流失濾料，查配水不均。
以反洗結束時間直接判定水質恢復。診斷與介入：以連續水質確認復原，將初濾排放從淨產水扣除。
循環水重複算成新產水。診斷與介入：分列毛產水、反洗、初濾排放與回流水，避免重複計數。
壓損降低被當作唯一清洗成功證據。診斷與介入：比較分層測壓、流量與水溫，區分堵塞與流量變化。
pitfallsEn: All installed area is used while one cell is backwashing. Diagnostic response: Recalculate using online area and check cell flows/quality.
Bulk bed volume is treated as water volume. Diagnostic response: Check effective depth, porosity estimate and bypass, measuring effluent particles separately.
Every pressure rise is blamed on fouling while increased flow is missed. Diagnostic response: Compare multi-level heads, flow and temperature to distinguish clogging from changed flow.
Longest runtime is pursued despite breakthrough. Diagnostic response: Include endpoint quality, wash downtime and filter-to-waste in usable output.
Wash conditions are copied across different media or temperatures. Diagnostic response: Compare temperature, bed expansion and washwater within validated equipment conditions.
Only one corner of the bed is observed. Diagnostic response: Measure bed height/media loss at several positions and check uneven distribution.
Equal total wash flow hides local jets and dead zones. Diagnostic response: Measure bed height/media loss at several positions and check uneven distribution.
Wash completion time is used as proof of restored quality. Diagnostic response: Confirm recovery with continuous quality and subtract filter-to-waste from net production.
Recycled water is counted repeatedly as new production. Diagnostic response: Separate gross production, backwash, filter-to-waste and recycle without double-counting.
Lower head loss is the sole evidence of successful cleaning. Diagnostic response: Compare multi-level heads, flow and temperature to distinguish clogging from changed flow.

courses.connection: 本課以濾程、水頭損失、床層膨脹與恢復為主線，從進水顆粒與濾速、床層與孔隙水、累積壓損與截污、濾程終點比較進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
courses.connectionEn: This course develops filter runs, head loss, bed expansion and return to service through ten connected units, beginning with influent particles and filtration rate, bed and pore water, head-loss growth and retained solids, comparing run endpoints. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.
